programs.title: Kyo Kii... Main Jhuth Nahin Bolta
programs.desc: Raj is a lawyer who finds great success through his habit of lying. However, when his son wishes for his father to stop lying, Raj is magically forced to speak the truth and gets into trouble.

programs.title: Karobaar: The Business of Love
programs.desc: Friends Rajiv and Amar go their separate ways after Seema decides to be with Amar rather than Rajiv. Years later, prosecution lawyer Amar is delighted to see Rajiv in court and accused of murder.

programs.title: Zameer: The Fire Within
programs.desc: Pooja gets married to Suraj but feels guilty for separating him from Supriya, his former fiancee. When Suraj learns the truth he abandons her, oblivious to the fact that she is pregnant.

programs.title: Numbri Aadmi
programs.desc: Shankar, a noble thief, attempts to kill Rana, his father's murderer, in a bid to seek revenge. However, Rana has powerful friends who stand in Shankar's way.

programs.title: The Murderer: Hamilton Palace
programs.desc: Rocky, a well-known singer and performer at an elite hotel, becomes the prime suspect when Maheema, a news reporter who was deeply in love with him, is found dead.

programs.title: Baabul
programs.desc: Will Malvika the widower be able to remove her husband Avinash from her heart and mind and marry someone else.
